title: Alumni Survey Questionnaire
purpose: This survey aims to assess the work environment, management efficiency, and resource adequacy within the Law Discipline. Your feedback is essential for the Self-Assessment Report (SAR) required for BAC Accreditation.
confidentiality: This survey is strictly anonymous. Data will be aggregated for quality assurance purposes only. No individual will be identified in the reporting.
scale: 1 = Strongly Disagree / Very Poor | 2 = Disagree / Poor | 3 = Neutral / Average | 4 = Agree / Good | 5 = Strongly Agree / Excellent

questions.text: The academic program prepared me well for my current profession (e.g., Advocate, Judge, Corporate Officer).
The legal knowledge (substantive and procedural law) I gained is relevant to my daily work.
The curriculum balanced theoretical knowledge with practical skills (drafting, pleading, opinions).
The General Education courses (e.g., English, ICT, History, Economics) helped broaden my professional skills.
The program enhanced my ability to adapt to changes in the legal landscape (e.g., new laws, technology).

sections.title: Part B: Attainment of Graduate Attributes

questions.text: Legal Research Skills: Ability to find and analyze case law/statutes.
Communication Skills: Oral advocacy and professional writing.
Problem Solving: Ability to apply law to complex factual scenarios.
Ethical Development: Understanding professional ethics and moral responsibility.
ICT Skills: Proficiency in using technology for legal work.
Leadership & Team Spirit: Ability to work in teams and lead initiatives.
Creativity & Innovation: Ability to think outside the box in legal arguments.
The faculty members were qualified and effective in their teaching methods.
The assessment methods (exams/assignments) were fair and challenged my critical thinking.
Moot Court: The mooting and mock trial exercises were sufficient and useful for my career.
Library/IT: The learning resources (books, journals, computer labs) were adequate during my study.
Co-Curriculars: Participation in debating, clubs, or negotiation role-plays helped mold my personality.
The university's Career Placement Cell provided useful guidance for my job search/internship.
I feel a strong sense of connection/belonging to the university.
The Alumni Association is active and provides networking opportunities.
The department seeks feedback from alumni regarding curriculum review and development.
